crossRefs.note: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord…

translations.web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
translations.bsb: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
translations.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell
translations.asv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
